## Company Overview

Levitate operates in Enterprise Software and is based in Raleigh, North Carolina. Its latest recorded funding round was a Series E round in March 2026.

Levitate is a software company that provides an AI-powered relationship marketing platform designed to help small and medium-sized businesses manage client relationships through personalized communication tools, content, and analytics.
